entries.title: Under the SADBRIDGE with GOSAR: QUASAR Gets a Golang Rewrite
entries.description: Elastic Security Labs share details about the SADBRIDGE loader and GOSAR backdoor, malware used in campaigns targeting Chinese-speaking victims.

entries.title: Declawing PUMAKIT
entries.description: PUMAKIT is a sophisticated loadable kernel module (LKM) rootkit that employs advanced stealth mechanisms to hide its presence and maintain communication with command-and-control servers.

entries.title: Exploring AWS STS AssumeRoot
entries.description: Explore AWS STS AssumeRoot, its risks, detection strategies, and practical scenarios to secure against privilege escalation and account compromise using Elastic's SIEM and CloudTrail data.
